job.title: Head Orthoptist
job.description:
MAYDAY Healthcare is proud to be partnering with a leading multi-subspecialty ophthalmology clinic located in Sydney Eastern Suburbs.

This highly regarded practice is home to a team of respected ophthalmologists and experienced clinical professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional patient care across the full spectrum of eye health.

We are seeking an experienced Head Orthoptist to lead and develop a team of Orthoptists while partnering closely with ophthalmologists to drive clinical excellence, operational efficiency, and exceptional patient outcomes.

Offering a salary of up to $140,000 + Super, this is an outstanding opportunity for an accomplished Orthoptist to step into a key leadership position where they can influence team culture, shape clinical standards, and support the development of the next generation of Orthoptists.

What's on Offer

  • Salary up to $140,000 + Super
  • Genuine leadership opportunity within a well-established specialist practice
  • Lead, mentor and develop a team of 3-4 Orthoptists
  • Play a key role in onboarding, training and developing future Orthoptists
  • Opportunity to shape clinical standards, policies and procedures
  • Work closely with highly respected ophthalmologists and practice leaders
  • Exposure across a broad range of ophthalmology subspecialties
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture
  • Metro location with onsite parking available and close proximity to train and public transport options
  • Ongoing professional development opportunities

The Role

As Head Orthoptist, you will combine hands-on clinical responsibilities with leadership and operational oversight, acting as a key link between the Orthoptist team, specialists and practice leadership.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Leading, mentoring and developing a team of 3-4 Orthoptists
  • Supporting the onboarding, training and professional growth of new team members
  • Creating, reviewing and implementing clinical policies and procedures
  • Driving consistency, quality and best-practice standards across the clinic
  • Working closely with ophthalmologists to support exceptional patient outcomes
  • Managing clinic flow and ensuring efficient day-to-day operations
  • Providing leadership, guidance and support within a busy clinical environment
  • Conducting comprehensive patient assessments and consultations
  • Performing and overseeing ophthalmic diagnostic testing
  • Supporting pre-operative and post-operative patient care
  • Assisting with clinical audits, quality improvement initiatives and compliance requirements
  • Building strong relationships across the wider multidisciplinary team
  • Identifying opportunities to improve workflows, patient experience and team performance

About You

We're looking for a natural leader who is calm under pressure, empathetic with their team and patients, yet confident enough to provide clear direction and uphold standards when required.

You'll bring:

  • Qualification as an Orthoptist with current Australian registration
  • Significant experience within an ophthalmology setting
  • Previous leadership, mentoring or senior clinical experience
  • A calm, empathetic and professional leadership style
  • The confidence to make decisions and have difficult conversations when required
  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to work collaboratively with specialists and support teams
  • A passion for coaching, developing and supporting others
  • Excellent organisational, communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience developing or working within policies, procedures and clinical governance frameworks
  • A proactive approach with the ability to balance clinical and operational responsibilities

Why This Opportunity?

This role offers far more than a traditional senior Orthoptist position.

You'll have the opportunity to influence team culture, develop future Orthoptists, strengthen clinical standards, and become a trusted partner to a highly respected group of ophthalmologists. We are looking for someone with the emotional intelligence to support and grow a team, the resilience to navigate challenges, and the leadership capability to drive continuous improvement across the service.

If you're looking for a leadership role where you can make a genuine impact while remaining clinically involved, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact Siobhan Filen on 02 8311 5645 or siobhan@maydayhealthcare.com.au for a confidential discussion.
